knowledge.text: Day 62: The group consumed much from storage today. ルオ caught only 1 fish, then took it along with 20 seeds from storage. セナ and ウィロ also took from storage. The reserves are now critically depleted. Tomorrow my gathering at the river and ルオ's hunting are absolutely essential for the group to survive.

feeling: お腹が空いて死にそうだ。でも南の川なら必ず成功させる。明日が全てだ。
